question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A piece of cake
solution:
The correct answer is: **An easy task**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom "**A piece of cake**" means something that is very easy to do. (कुछ ऐसा जो करना बहुत आसान है)

 
 
• Example - *The boy found the project to be a piece of cake because it was incredibly easy.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**A piece of cake**" is "An easy task"

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
